guidance.summary: Medium- to long-term EBIT margin guidance for Wires & Cables business.
guidance.speaker: Niyant Maru
guidance.quote: Consistent with our Project Spring roadmap, we continue to maintain our medium- to long- term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.

guidance.summary: Target EBITDA margins for FMEG business by FY 2030.
guidance.speaker: Niyant Maru
guidance.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were 8%, very much in line with the milestones laid out under Project Spring, where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.

guidance.summary: FMEG segment target to grow at 1.5x to 2x industry growth.
guidance.speaker: Niyant Maru
guidance.quote: Our strategic priorities remain unchanged to grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth while progressively enhancing profitability.

guidance.summary: Long-term operating range for working capital cycle is 45-50 days.
guidance.speaker: Niyant Maru
guidance.quote: As these effects normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to settle within our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.

guidance.summary: Long-term expected EBIT margins for EPC business are high single digits.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: This quarter, we have delivered EBIT of 11% in our EPC business, but we estimate that from a long-term perspective, it should be high single digit.

guidance.summary: Company guides to grow at 1.5x of market growth.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: But I think we have always guided that we will do 1.5x of market growth, which is a mix of both volume and value.

guidance.qualifier: Bharat Net and RDSS order book
guidance.summary: Combined order book for Bharat Net and RDSS stands at INR 10,900 crores.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: But overall, put together, Bharat Net and RDSS, the order book stands at around INR 10,900 crores.

guidance.summary: Expected RDSS revenue translation of about INR 800 crores in FY27.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: And again, in case of RDSS, since the execution piece is around 3 years, we should expect about INR 800-odd crores translating this year.

guidance.summary: Company expects to grow at 1.5x market growth until FY30.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: We have guided that we'll continue to grow at 1.5x of market growth. And we still believe in that, and we have delivered that in the last 1-1.5 years ever since we have made that commitment. And we believe that will continue to happen until FY30.

guidance.qualifier: exports as percentage of top line
guidance.summary: Exports target to exceed 10% of overall top line by 2030.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: We have given our guidance of going north of 10% of our overall top line by 2030.

guidance.summary: Ambition to reach 8% to 10% EBITDA margins for FMEG annually.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
guidance.quote: And of course, the ambition is that on a full year basis, we should be able to reach 8% to 10% of EBITDA margins on FMEG.
